import sys
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.sql.functions import (
    col,
    year,
    avg as spark_avg,
    lower,
    regexp_replace,
    trim,
    coalesce,
    lit,
    max as spark_max
)
from pyspark.sql.types import DoubleType

args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME'])

sc = SparkContext()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session
job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

bucket = "propelnoi-vijay-datalake"

properties_path = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/portfolio/properties/"
rent_roll_path = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/portfolio/rent_roll/"
insideairbnb_path = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/market/insideairbnb/"
worldbank_path = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/economic/worldbank/"
output_path = f"s3://{bucket}/curated/market_rent_features/"

# Read processed datasets
properties_df = spark.read.parquet(properties_path)
rent_roll_df = spark.read.parquet(rent_roll_path)
insideairbnb_df = spark.read.parquet(insideairbnb_path)
worldbank_df = spark.read.parquet(worldbank_path)

# Portfolio monthly average rent
portfolio_rent_df = (
    rent_roll_df
    .groupBy("property_id", "month")
    .agg(
        spark_avg(col("rent_income")).alias("avg_portfolio_rent")
    )
)

# Add city and normalized city key
portfolio_with_city_df = (
    portfolio_rent_df.alias("r")
    .join(
        properties_df.select("property_id", "city").alias("p"),
        col("r.property_id") == col("p.property_id"),
        "left"
    )
    .select(
        col("r.property_id").alias("property_id"),
        col("r.month").alias("month"),
        col("p.city").alias("city"),
        col("r.avg_portfolio_rent").alias("avg_portfolio_rent")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "city_key",
        lower(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(trim(col("city")), ",", ""),
                    "\\.", ""
                ),
                "\\s+",
                "_"
            )
        )
    )
)

# Market benchmark by normalized city
market_rent_df = (
    insideairbnb_df
    .withColumn(
        "city_key",
        lower(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(trim(col("city")), ",", ""),
                    "\\.", ""
                ),
                "\\s+",
                "_"
            )
        )
    )
    .groupBy("city_key")
    .agg(
        spark_avg(col("price")).alias("avg_market_rent")
    )
)

# United States inflation
inflation_df = (
    worldbank_df
    .filter(col("country_name") == "United States")
    .select(
        col("year").alias("inflation_year"),
        col("inflation_value").cast(DoubleType()).alias("inflation_rate")
    )
)

# Latest available inflation year/value for fallback
latest_year = (
    inflation_df
    .agg(spark_max("inflation_year").alias("max_year"))
    .collect()[0]["max_year"]
)

latest_inflation_rate = (
    inflation_df
    .filter(col("inflation_year") == lit(latest_year))
    .select("inflation_rate")
    .collect()[0]["inflation_rate"]
)

# Join portfolio + market + inflation
joined_df = (
    portfolio_with_city_df.alias("pf")
    .join(
        market_rent_df.alias("m"),
        col("pf.city_key") == col("m.city_key"),
        "left"
    )
    .join(
        inflation_df.alias("i"),
        year(col("pf.month")) == col("i.inflation_year"),
        "left"
    )
)

# Calculate recommended rent and rent gap with inflation fallback
final_df = (
    joined_df
    .withColumn(
        "inflation_rate",
        coalesce(col("i.inflation_rate"), lit(latest_inflation_rate))
    )
    .withColumn(
        "recommended_rent",
        col("avg_market_rent") * (1 + col("inflation_rate") / 100)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "rent_gap",
        col("avg_portfolio_rent") - col("recommended_rent")
    )
    .select(
        col("pf.property_id").alias("property_id"),
        col("pf.month").alias("month"),
        col("pf.city").alias("city"),
        col("avg_portfolio_rent"),
        col("avg_market_rent"),
        col("recommended_rent"),
        col("rent_gap"),
        col("inflation_rate")
    )
)

# Write curated dataset
final_df.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(output_path)

job.commit()
